header: View insights and suggested support articles
content:
In case the suggested articles aren't sufficient, you can open a service request.
To open a service request, select the Contact support. This opens a form where you can
provide details about the issue you're facing.
1. Fill in a title and description for the issue you're facing, the phone number and email
address where we can reach you.
2. (Optional) Include up to five attachments that are relevant to the issue to provide
additional context for the support case.
3. Select your time zone and an alternative language, if applicable. The request is sent to
Microsoft Support Team.

